## The rung's exit

- [ ] `just check` green locally and in CI
- [ ] the book changed in the same change where behaviour, shape or a rule changed (Vitality)
- [ ] every lesson this rung owes is a test or a rule ([lessons](../docs/lessons.md))
- [ ] milestone close only: a fresh Fable review, findings fixed or filed
- [ ] usage recorded in `.tempest/log.md`: tokens per model, share of the plan window (`npx ccusage`)
